scope:
Constraint sheet: the eyes as a fill-in puzzle (notes/plaintext/constraint-sheet.md).

Cells are (message, position), positions 1.. (position 0 is the header, outside the cipher).
Rules come in tiers so each assumption can be switched off:
  openings  equal letters while two messages share an opening; different at the first split
            (common start deck, one letter per symbol)
  cores     the four named shared-passage cores (isomorph_catalog.ANCHORS), as on the guess board
  extended  every calibrated catalogued copy relation (copy_anatomy relations), but only at cells
            whose symbol repeats inside the copy window (HYP-002: repeated-symbol positions are equal
            letters), minus copy_anatomy's minimal exceptions. Offset-0 rows of a resync pair (iso-009,
            E1/W1) are left to the resync tier when it is on
  spans     optional upper bound: tie every cell of each copy core, as if the whole window were copied
            text. Cells with symbols seen nowhere else in the window carry no evidence, and a variable
            field can sit inside a window unseen (E1/W1 33-36 inside iso-008/iso-002), so this over-ties
  extensions  optional, with spans: use copy_anatomy's maximal consistent extension instead of the core
  candidates  the uncalibrated or candidate rows (copy_anatomy.CANDIDATES: iso-018/019/027/028/029),
            core cells only
  resync    no lifts: inside the E1/W1 and E4/E5 resync windows, equal eyes are equal letters and
            unequal eyes are different letters of the same class (minimal exceptions dropped)
Output: tied letter variables, the free (untied) runs that are the slots to fill, length relations,
must-differ pairs and same-class pairs.

  uv run python tools/explore/constraint_sheet.py [--tiers openings,cores,extended,resync] [--json out]
